purpose: Close qualification phase 11 with an online digest of every exact post-head integer probability consumed by the arithmetic coder and seven mutation-scoped persistent-state checkpoints, without retaining a multi-terabyte bit trace.
activation_dependencies: cmix_filebacked_fxcm_full_a_qm8_v1 is terminal, exact, independently verified, and resource-clean
one independent full roundtrip B is terminal, exact, independently verified, and byte-identical to A
the opening-100M identity/resource receipt and its independent verification are terminal passes
the opening/distant 10M observer calibration and independent verification are terminal passes for the exact shared observer binary
the exclusive full1g lease and its acquisition lock are absent

modeled_coordinate_correction.evidence: The canonical raw population is 1,000,000,000 bytes, while retained q1 preprocessing creates a 934,220,701-byte .ready4cmix modeled stream. The opening 10M calibration similarly produces only 5,766,051 modeled bytes.
modeled_coordinate_correction.correction: Schemas no longer hard-code the terminal coder checkpoint as raw byte 1,000,000,000. Each arm binds the transformed stream artifact; the terminal modeled checkpoint must equal that artifact's byte count, and the verifier rederives this relationship independently.

retained_trace_semantics.identity_build_behavior: The observer taps the final uint16 after KhBitLstm32Head::Adjust and immediately before arithmetic xmid computation.
retained_trace_semantics.calibration_rule: The online little-endian uint16 digest must reproduce both retained post-head opening and distant 10M trace digests.

pageout_cadence_reachability.resource_interpretation: qm8 uses constructor PageOutAll plus kernel reclaim induced by cgroup memory.high; it does not exercise the declared periodic ByteUpdate pageout cadence.
pageout_cadence_reachability.identity_consequence: None: the unreachable hook performs residency advice only and is outside predictor arithmetic.

python_source_closure.population: The coordinator, arm runner, and independent verifier plus all recursively imported project-local Python and research-contract schema files.
python_source_closure.failure_rule: Any missing, extra, reordered, or hash-divergent closure row rejects execution or independent verification before identity authority is interpreted.

opening_100m_harness_closure.population: The opening-100M coordinator, identity arm, independent verifier, release stage, observer build, calibration runner, calibration verifier, and their transitive local dependencies.
opening_100m_harness_closure.separation_rule: The 149-member Python/schema harness closure is independent of q1's retained candidate source closure and is rebound by the opening-100M receipt and verifier.

observer_contract.extended_checkpoint_environment: GAMMA_FULL_IDENTITY_EXTENDED_CHECKPOINTS=1 only for full arms; absence is the sealed 10M and opening-100M mode
observer_contract.probability_tap: Encoder::Encode after optional KhBitLstm32Head::Adjust and immediately before xmid is computed
observer_contract.probability_record: Two bytes containing the final uint16 probability in little-endian order
observer_contract.probability_digest: SHA-256 updated online through a bounded buffer; no per-bit trace is retained
observer_contract.probability_bit_count: Count only Encoder::Encode calls; exclude EncodeRawBit and ObserveKnownBit exactly as retained KH_TRACE does
observer_contract.coder_checkpoints: At each completed modeled-byte checkpoint, record x1, x2, emitted-payload-byte count, coded-bit count, and a clone-finalized rolling probability digest without resetting it.
observer_contract.observer_failure: Any open, write, flush, counter, geometry, checkpoint-order, or finalization failure terminates the diagnostic arm; observation may never silently disable itself.

mutation_read_write_scope: fxcmv1::alloc allocations at or above 67108864 bytes
fxcmv1::alloc1 semantic data ranges at or above 67108864 bytes
persistent_state_contract.completeness_argument: The q1 semantic patch changes only allocation, release, and residency handling for these source-ordered large FXCM ranges. Predictor, head, mixer, coder, preprocessing, and every small allocation remain source-identical.
persistent_state_contract.registration: Both observer arms register the same source-ordered semantic ranges. Parent uses calloc-backed addresses; q1 uses each mapping's aligned usable pointer and requested semantic bytes. Addresses, filenames, inode numbers, padding, mapping slack, residency, and fault history are excluded.
persistent_state_contract.checkpoint_digest: Each range hashes allocation ordinal, requested semantic bytes, alignment, and exact semantic contents; an ordered aggregate hashes the 26 range records.
persistent_state_contract.q1_residency_rule: Hash q1 mappings in bounded chunks and issue only content-preserving pageout advice after each fully hashed semantic range. This phase is diagnostic and confers no resource or runtime qualification.
persistent_state_contract.parent_residency_rule: Hash parent ranges read-only. Parent observer memory is diagnostic and is not judged against q1's prize ceiling.
persistent_state_contract.identity_rule: Parent and q1 must have identical allocation geometry, checkpoint coordinates, every per-range digest, aggregate manifests, coder records, final probability digest, transformed stream, payload, and return code. State equality is claimed only at seven frozen checkpoints; probability identity covers every modeled bit.

controls: Observer-off retained and observer-on calibrated packages emit byte-identical opening-10M payloads
Online post-head digests reproduce both retained 10M post-head digests and exact bit counts
A pre-head tap differs from the post-head digest while leaving payload and state unchanged
A copied-state single-byte mutation changes both its range digest and aggregate manifest
Checkpoint omission, duplication, reordering, wrong coded-bit count, and wrong terminal coordinate are rejected by both coordinator and independent verifier
Two observer builds from the same frozen closure are byte-identical within parent and q1 arms

resource_boundary.reason: The external parent is already known to exceed the strict prize memory ceiling, and state snapshots deliberately fault semantic ranges. These arms are bounded diagnostics only; qm8 A/B remain resource authority.

execution_order: reopen terminal qm8 A/B and opening-100M independent verification
reuse the exact independently calibrated shared observer build
run authoritative parent full byte-zero observer encode alone
run q1 full byte-zero observer encode alone from clean scratch and backing roots
independently reparse every observer manifest and rederive all controls and antecedents
emit phase-11 identity authority only if every predicate passes
terminal_pass: Every activation, calibration, probability, coder, persistent-state, transformed-stream, payload, build, control, artifact, and independent-verification predicate is true.
terminal_identity_failure: Classify q1 as a new compression candidate without parent-preserving authority and restart its archive ladder. Do not reinterpret payload equality as state identity.
terminal_observer_failure: Preserve all evidence and authorize at most one observer-only correction; no semantic conclusion follows.
claim_boundary: A pass proves parent preservation for the exact q1 allocation/residency mutation under the frozen source, corpus, head, compiler, and host. It grants no Gamma compression bytes, score credit, runtime qualification, or prize authority.
